name: Ghost Ship (Seven Seas)
summary: Seven Seas Entertainment's wildly successful dedicated 18+ print & digital imprint bringing uncensored ecchi and spicy manga legally to bookstores.
ranking_rationale: Major mainstream North American publisher delivering physical & digital uncut releases (trade-off: digital releases vary by storefront — BookWalker, Kindle, Kobo).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Major mainstream North American publisher delivering physical & digital uncut releases
High translation, lettering, and print production standards
Broad ecchi, yuri, and horror-erotica hits
cons: Digital releases vary by storefront (BookWalker, Kindle, Kobo)
Tame next to hardcore Fakku doujinshi—focuses on mainstream 18+ serialized manga
